scope: Read-only static evidence for one bounded pool helper; no original execution or canonical edits.

function_extent.next_entry_evidence: 0x4a30 begins a distinct stack-frame prologue (sub esp,8); archaeology index has incoming direct-call lead from 0x76c2.

callers.verified_site: 0x48b4 calls 0x49f0; caller pushes pool id EDI at 0x48b3, then uses EAX-1 at 0x48b9 for compact reverse ordinal loop.
callers.limitation: SQLite linear decode exposes direct-call leads; absence of additional leads does not exclude opaque indirect use.

precise_behavior: cdecl one-dword pool_id argument; EAX starts at zero and is returned as the count.
Loads start and end pointer cells at g_host_pool base plus 4*pool_id and +0x10 respectively; no pool-id bounds check is present.
The range is end-exclusive: if start >= end, returns zero.
For each cursor < end, reads only descriptor word0. Counts one iff bit31 (POOL_FREE) is clear; pinned bit30 does not exclude a block from the count.
Advances by (descriptor & 0x3fffffff) dword words (scale four bytes), then repeats. The target has no zero-size guard; no malformed-block behavior is invented.

reinitializer_scope_decision.observed_context: callback slot 0x29 points to 0x4470 per evidence/host_pool_layout.json; it mutates saved arena/size, rebuilds pool0 header, calls coalesce and diagnostic.
reinitializer_scope_decision.decision: Do not pair: count_used is directly called only from compact_pool and needs only the already-reviewed start/end cells and descriptor stride/free bit. The arena reinitializer is separately callback-bound and is not needed to establish the helper boundary, callers, or semantics.

candidate_model_limits: Private alias count_used; original name, declaration and translation unit are not proven. The minimal PoolWord and HostPoolState view expresses observed field offsets only.
